<thought>Based on the observed ESI‑MS peak at m/z 141.115 (assumed [M+H]⁺), the neutral molecular mass is ≈140.108 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1) suggests about eight carbon atoms. The formula that best fits this mass and carbon count is C₈H₁₂O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H12O2</final_answer>
